server.cli.usage: redgem-server <game_dir> [options]    run a game on a server, for players to join over the internet
--port <number>           the port to listen on (default: {default_port}; 0 picks a free one)
--per-address <number>    machines one address may connect (default: {default_per_address}, at most {most_per_address}; players
behind one shared address, a campus, may need more)
--data <dir>              where the game's Save is kept, for every room (default: a folder beside
the game's, named after it with {data_suffix})
--max-players <number>    players in one room (default: {default_players}, at most {most_players})
--rooms <number>          rooms open at once, each a match of its own (default: {default_rooms}, at most {most_rooms})
